operations.title: Read a public symbol
operations.summary: What *target* is and how to use it, read from its source (nothing is imported).

target.description: A public symbol as `search` lists it (`"mayatk.mat_utils._mat_utils:MatUtils.get_mat_info"`; a C# one by its full name, `"M3trik.Unitytk.Core.Json.Parse"`).

operations.title: Find a public symbol
operations.summary: The public symbols whose target or summary names every word of *query*.

query.description: Words to match, in any case: a name, part of one, a topic (`"material texture path"`). Empty lists every one.

packages.description: The packages to search; default: every one registered with pythontk (`registered`), but any of those that is no package here (logged, then passed over).

limit.description: The most to return (`None`: all); those whose name holds every word come first.

operations.title: Check agent instructions
operations.summary: Report every way the instruction tree under *root* breaks the layout.

source.description: The packs' source folder, to check the vendored copies against.

standard.description: A standards document whose `## N.` sections the instructions cite as `§N`; each citation must resolve.

mode.description: How the root's packs reach Claude Code: `"hook"` (a repo) or `"import"` (a workspace root).

operations.title: Find duplicated rules
operations.summary: Rules written more than once across the instruction files under *root*.

root.description: The folder to read (its `AGENTS.md`, `CLAUDE.md` with rules, vendored packs and `.claude/rules`).

threshold.description: The share of words two rules must have in common (Jaccard, words of three letters or more).

operations.title: Measure what a session loads
operations.summary: What a Claude Code session rooted at *root* loads from instruction files.

touched.description: Paths the session reads or edits, in order.

operations.title: Sync agent instructions
operations.summary: Bring the instruction tree under *root* in line with the layout.

source.description: The packs' source folder (needed to add or refresh packs).

packs.description: Pack names to add to the ones already vendored.

mode.description: `"hook"` for a repo, `"import"` for a workspace root.

operations.title: Narrate a sheet's voice lines
operations.summary: Narrate a sheet's voice lines (`narration.render`): every step's voice text that no recording covers, into the folder its mapping's `narrate` method names, so reading the sheet finds them.

mapping.description: Its template's name (`default`, `linear`, `interactive`), or a mapping file's path.

base.description: The project folder relative audio folders are read against (where its settings live).

accept.description: Step IDs whose recordings are accepted for their current lines.

prune.description: Remove narration files no line uses (asked; a person's file never).

workers.description: Engine runs at once (0: chosen from the cores).

prompt.description: Ask before the narration engine's first install (about 170 MB); False installs it unasked (the caller consents). Where nobody can be asked (no console, no *confirm*), nothing is downloaded and the run stops.

operations.title: Rewrite a package's catalog
operations.summary: Rewrite *module*'s committed catalog from its declarations, when it changed; returns its path.

provider.description: The provider's name in the catalog; default: the module's top package.

operations.title: Check every package's operations
operations.summary: Check providers: each catalog current and within the rules, and twins across them agreeing.

modules.description: The providers to check: declaration modules, or catalog files another language writes; default: every provider registered under the `pythontk.operations` entry points.

operations.title: Onboard a package
operations.summary: Onboard *package*: its declaration module, its entry point and its first catalog, each made only where it is missing (running it again changes nothing).

operations.title: Run Python
operations.summary: Run *code* in the console namespace, as the next snippet typed into a console.

code.description: Python source: statements, then optionally an expression whose value comes back. Names it defines stay for later calls.

operations.title: Start a build sheet from its template's starter
operations.summary: Start a new sheet (`sheet.new`): *template*'s starter sheet written to *out*, to rename and fill.

out.description: The CSV to write. A file that exists is never replaced.

template.description: A template that ships a starter (`interactive`, `linear`).
